name: – Pasquale Tridico – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section VII – Committee of the Regions
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the Committee of the Regions spent its 2024 budget. The Committee represents local and regional authorities in the European Union. Parliament notes that its spending was well managed, with almost all of its budget used and no major errors found. Parliament also asks the Committee to save costs, justify payments for online meetings, do more to reach gender balance in management, and adopt a full anti-fraud strategy. This is an assessment and a set of recommendations, not a new law.

- Parliament formally approves the Committee of the Regions' 2024 spending; the Committee and its staff are affected.
- Parliament asks for cost savings, clearer rules on remote meeting payments, and a full anti-fraud strategy.
- The decision is sent to the Committee, the Council, the Commission and the Court of Auditors, and published.
